skill.summary: Generate, schedule, and publish tweets in your voice using AI. Browse viral content, manage preferences, and track billing.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of xreply: generate and manage AI-powered tweets

- Generate, schedule, and publish tweets in your own voice using AI
- Browse viral tweets for inspiration, filter by niche, keyword, and time range
- Manage drafts, edit, schedule, delete, and publish posts to Twitter/X
- Track billing, post quota, and subscription status
- Set and update preferences for tone, emoji usage, and writing structure
- List and manage custom writing rules (Pro/BYOK)
- Command-line usage examples and workflow guides included
